A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 14-page TADFormer paper, including supplementary Sections 6-8 and references. Full-text and rendered-page comparisons establish that only the first-page arXiv version/date stamp differs.

before.justification: v1 reports original PASCAL-Context experiments, component ablations, and supplementary decoder, computational-efficiency, and adapter experiments.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experiments and results in Tables 1-4 and the accompanying main-text and supplementary figures.

M1.justification: The TADFormer architecture, task prompts, TPC operator, Dynamic Task Filter, gating, training objective, and supplementary adapter adaptations are identical.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same four PASCAL-Context tasks and ImageNet-1k/ImageNet-22k pretraining coverage. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 1, 3, and 4 retain identical comparator sets, including MTLoRA, AdaptFormer, and VMT-Adapter in their respective comparisons.

E3.justification: The 4,998/5,105 training/testing split, evaluation metrics, backbone and decoder configurations, ranks, and adapter comparison protocols are unchanged.

E4.justification: Table 2's component ablations, attention visualizations, backbone and decoder analyses, computational-efficiency analysis, and adapter-extension experiments are all retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical throughout both PDFs. Neither adds repeated-run counts, seeds, uncertainty estimates, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical entries, plotted results, and qualitative findings match. For example, Table 1 reports the same +3.63% relative improvement and 4.78 million trainable parameters for TADFormer with rank 32.

T1.justification: Equations (1)-(7) and their mathematical definitions and explanations are identical. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims about task-adaptive features, accuracy, and parameter efficiency.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations, result interpretations, applicability claims, and qualifications are unchanged, including Section 7's tradeoff between slightly higher GFLOPs and fewer trainable parameters.

D1.justification: Implementation and hardware disclosures are identical, including ranks 16/32/64 and the single NVIDIA V100 setup. The statement that adapter-experiment code was submitted as supplementary material is also unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, positioning against prior PEFT and multi-task methods, and all 59 reference entries are identical.

P1.justification: Only the marginal arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 8 Jan 2025 to v2 dated 28 Mar 2025. The paper's wording, headings, and document structure are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1-12, Tables 1-4, captions, and body layout are identical. Rendered pages 2-14 match exactly; page 1 differs only in the marginal version/date text.

improvement.justification: The later PDF changes only the arXiv version/date stamp. The scientific content, supplementary evidence, reproducibility information, and substantive presentation are identical, establishing no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
